CODE_OF_CONDUCT.content:
# Contributor Covenant Code of Conduct

## Our Pledge

We as members, contributors, and leaders pledge to make participation in our community a
harassment-free experience for everyone, regardless of age, body size, visible or invisible
disability, ethnicity, sex characteristics, gender identity and expression, level of experience,
education, socio-economic status, nationality, personal appearance, race, caste, color, religion,
or sexual identity and orientation.

We pledge to act and interact in ways that contribute to an open, welcoming, diverse, inclusive,
and healthy community.

## Our Standards

Examples of behavior that contributes to a positive environment for our community include:

* Demonstrating empathy and kindness toward other people
* Being respectful of differing opinions, viewpoints, and experiences
* Giving and gracefully accepting constructive feedback
* Accepting responsibility and apologizing to those affected by our mistakes, and learning from
  the experience
* Focusing on what is best not just for us as individuals, but for the overall community

Examples of unacceptable behavior include:

* The use of sexualized language or imagery, and sexual attention or advances of any kind
* Trolling, insulting or derogatory comments, and personal or political attacks
* Public or private harassment
* Publishing others' private information, such as a physical or email address, without their
  explicit permission
* Other conduct which could reasonably be considered inappropriate in a professional setting

## Enforcement Responsibilities

Community leaders are responsible for clarifying and enforcing our standards of acceptable
behavior and will take appropriate and fair corrective action in response to any behavior that
they deem inappropriate, threatening, offensive, or harmful.

Community leaders have the right and responsibility to remove, edit, or reject comments, commits,
code, wiki edits, issues, and other contributions that are not aligned to this Code of Conduct,
and will communicate reasons for moderation decisions when appropriate.

## Scope

This Code of Conduct applies within all community spaces, and also applies when an individual is
officially representing the community in public spaces. Examples of representing our community
include using an official e-mail address, posting via an official social media account, or acting
as an appointed representative at an online or offline event.

## Enforcement

Instances of abusive, harassing, or otherwise unacceptable behavior may be reported to the
community leaders responsible for enforcement at [INSERT CONTACT METHOD]. All complaints will be
reviewed and investigated promptly and fairly.

All community leaders are obligated to respect the privacy and security of the reporter of any
incident.

## Enforcement Guidelines

Community leaders will follow these Community Impact Guidelines in determining the consequences
for any action they deem in violation of this Code of Conduct:

### 1. Correction

**Community Impact**: Use of inappropriate language or other behavior deemed unprofessional or
unwelcome in the community.

**Consequence**: A private, written warning from community leaders, providing clarity around the
nature of the violation and an explanation of why the behavior was inappropriate. A public
apology may be requested.

### 2. Warning

**Community Impact**: A violation through a single incident or series of actions.

**Consequence**: A warning with consequences for continued behavior. No interaction with the
people involved, including unsolicited interaction with those enforcing the Code of Conduct, for
a specified period of time. This includes avoiding interactions in community spaces as well as
external channels like social media. Violating these terms may lead to a temporary or permanent
ban.

### 3. Temporary Ban

**Community Impact**: A serious violation of community standards, including sustained
inappropriate behavior.

**Consequence**: A temporary ban from any sort of interaction or public communication with the
community for a specified period of time. No public or private interaction with the people
involved, including unsolicited interaction with those enforcing the Code of Conduct, is allowed
during this period. Violating these terms may lead to a permanent ban.

### 4. Permanent Ban

**Community Impact**: Demonstrating a pattern of violation of community standards, including
sustained inappropriate behavior, harassment of an individual, or aggression toward or
disparagement of classes of individuals.

**Consequence**: A permanent ban from any sort of public interaction within the community.

## Attribution

This Code of Conduct is adapted from the [Contributor Covenant][homepage], version 2.1,
available at [https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct.html][v2.1].

Community Impact Guidelines were inspired by [Mozilla's code of conduct enforcement
ladder][Mozilla CoC].

For answers to common questions about this code of conduct, see the FAQ at
[https://www.contributor-covenant.org/faq][FAQ]. Translations are available at
[https://www.contributor-covenant.org/translations][translations].

[homepage]: https://www.contributor-covenant.org
[v2.1]: https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct.html
[Mozilla CoC]: https://github.com/mozilla/diversity
[FAQ]: https://www.contributor-covenant.org/faq
[translations]: https://www.contributor-covenant.org/translations

opening_summary.text: Aspose.PDF FOSS for .NET is a free, open-source .NET 8+ library for developers to read, create, modify, and convert PDF documents. It provides an Aspose.PDF-compatible API surface for common PDF scenarios, supporting text extraction, forms, annotations, security, rendering, and conversion to/from HTML, SVG, Markdown, and plain text.

agentic_composition_plan.repository_summary: Aspose.PDF FOSS for .NET is a free, open-source .NET 8+ library for PDF document processing, offering a compatible API surface to Aspose.PDF for .NET with support for core document operations, text extraction, forms, annotations, security, rendering, and conversion to/from HTML, SVG, Markdown, and plain text.

section_decisions.rationale: The opening section accurately introduces the product identity and its relationship to the commercial edition, supported by the accepted facts.
The main heading 'Aspose.PDF FOSS for .NET' is appropriate and matches the product identity; no changes are required.
The Requirements section correctly states the .NET 8.0 minimum runtime requirement, which is verified by the compatibility manifest fact.
The Installation section accurately describes source build and NuGet acquisition, supported by the installation facts.
The 'What's included' section provides a comprehensive feature list aligned with the product capabilities and formats; no changes are required.
The Security section lacks dedicated repository-source evidence and requires verification of its content against the product facts.
The 'What's not included' section accurately describes feature gaps compared to the commercial edition, consistent with the commercial_foss relationship fact.
The Quick start section includes verified examples that compile against the repository source and match the documented public API.
The Documentation section provides a useful guide list and is consistent with the primary documentation links.
The API overview table lists key classes that align with the documented capabilities and public API surface.
The Running tests section is concise and accurate; no changes are required.
The Related projects section correctly describes the relationship to the commercial Aspose.PDF for .NET product.
The License section correctly identifies the MIT license, verified by the repository LICENSE file.
A fact-backed 'At a glance' section should be added to summarize the product's purpose and capabilities for the .NET developer audience.

operations.replacement_text:
# Aspose.PDF FOSS for .NET

[![NuGet: Aspose.PDF.FOSS](https://img.shields.io/nuget/v/Aspose.PDF.FOSS.svg?label=NuGet)](https://www.nuget.org/packages/Aspose.PDF.FOSS) ![Platform: .NET](https://img.shields.io/badge/Platform-.NET-blue) ![Requires: .NET net8.0](https://img.shields.io/badge/Requires-.NET%20net8.0-blue) [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-blue)](LICENSE) [![Contributors: aspose-pdf-foss/Aspose.PDF-FOSS-for-.NET](https://img.shields.io/github/contributors/aspose-pdf-foss/Aspose.PDF-FOSS-for-.NET.svg)](https://github.com/aspose-pdf-foss/Aspose.PDF-FOSS-for-.NET/graphs/contributors)

Aspose.PDF FOSS for .NET is a free, open-source .NET 8+ library for developers to read, create, modify, and convert PDF documents. It provides an Aspose.PDF-compatible API surface for common PDF scenarios, supporting text extraction, forms, annotations, security, rendering, and conversion to/from HTML, SVG, Markdown, and plain text.

## Navigation

- [At a glance](#at-a-glance)
- [Key capabilities](#key-capabilities)
- [Installation](#installation)
- [Quick start](#quick-start)
- [Scope and limitations](#scope-and-limitations)
- [License](#license)

## At a glance

  end

  subgraph Capabilities2["Core capabilities 2 of 2"]
    capability_7["Provides font management utilities for a document."]
    capability_8["/DocMDP /TransformParams /P access-permission levels per PDF 32000-1 §12.8.2.2."]
    capability_9["How widgets dependent on signature appearance are rendered when the form is"]

## Key capabilities

- Abstract base class for converting rendered images to indexed (1/4/8bpp) bitmaps.
- Default DocumentDevice implementation that saves the document as a PDF (Document.Save round-trip).
- Image extraction mode — matches docs.aspose.com Aspose.Pdf.ExtractImageMode.
- A single bookmark extracted from a document's outline tree by ExtractBookmarks().
- Facade for bookmark (outline) manipulation: create, extract, delete bookmarks.
- Provides font management utilities for a document.
- /DocMDP /TransformParams /P access-permission levels per PDF 32000-1 §12.8.2.2.
- How widgets dependent on signature appearance are rendered when the form is converted.

## Installation

Install the package published for this repository:

```bash
dotnet add package Aspose.PDF.FOSS --version 26.7.0
```

The package was verified against NuGet.

## Quick start

### Minimal verified example

```dotnet
using Aspose.Pdf;
using Aspose.Pdf.Text;

using var doc = new Document("input.pdf");
var absorber = new TextAbsorber();
absorber.Visit(doc.Pages[1]);
Console.WriteLine(absorber.Text);
```

## Scope and limitations

[Aspose.PDF FOSS for .NET](https://products.aspose.org/pdf/net/) and [Aspose.PDF Enterprise Edition](https://products.aspose.com/pdf/net/) are separate products. This README documents the FOSS implementation; do not assume API or feature parity beyond verified behavior.

## License

This project is available under the [MIT License](LICENSE). It permits use, modification, distribution, and commercial use when the license and copyright notice are retained.
